lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible traversing the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section with a slight increase in frequency/narrowing towards the anterior shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed at the dorsal apex of the 10th stripe (counting from posterior). Possible merging or convergence of the lower terminals of stripes 2 and 3 near the ventral line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 1 and 2 are abbreviated, failing to reach the dorsal ridge. Stripe 8 shows a distinct mid-body discontinuity where the line segment breaks and resumes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast spots is visible on the posterior haunch, located between the rump and the mid-thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-posterior thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron between the eyes; two white spots on the lateral snout; prominent white patch on the lower neck; dark dorsal crest of hair running along the spine.
